name: Online Store
description: Product catalog + client-side cart + checkout with server-side price validation, coupons, orders admin and optional Stripe Checkout. Manual payment (bank-transfer instructions) always available; Stripe is optional per-site.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read products, orders and coupons; read the Stripe secret key from the plugin's own settings table (options are a shared namespace, so the key lives in a wjp_ table).
Create/update products, orders and coupons; decrement stock and consume coupon uses atomically; store the write-only Stripe key in the plugin's own settings table.
Read the store configuration (currency, shipping fee, manual payment instructions, notification email).
Save the store configuration from the admin page.
Public catalog/checkout/order-lookup endpoints for the store block and admin CRUD endpoints.
Add the 'Tienda Online' entry to the admin sidebar.
Send order confirmations to customers and new-order notifications to the store email (best effort — orders are created even if mail fails).
Call the Stripe API (api.stripe.com) to create and verify Checkout Sessions when a Stripe key is configured.
